what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Niger in Benin: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3809 Nigerien asylum seekers in Benin, 17.6% of all asylum seekers from Niger.
Refugees from Niger, a separate group, live mostly in Mali, Nigeria, Benin and Chad.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Niger in every year from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Niger in 2007 and 2008 and, with JNIM, from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2003 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, the main year of displacement in the data.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Benin.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Benin only.
